decision.summaryForCoordinator: v3 lands CLAUDE-G21-V2-SF1 and touches nothing that had already landed. The coverage limb of the DR-G21 threshold is now bound rather than restated: a new componentAxis anchors the corpus to 'every external component identity admitted in the then-current D-002 slice', allExternalComponents was rewritten so the failing condition is an admitted identity ABSENT from the corpus, the global passProperty is quantified 'for every admitted external component identity on componentAxis', and two failsIf lines together cover the cross-product — absent identity fails, and a skipped class for a present identity fails. Because the first line forces the admitted set into the corpus, the second line's in-the-corpus qualifier is no longer circular. The axis is anchored correctly: slice1 names the TypeScript provider, which the live register records as 'D-002: TypeScript, sole slice-1 role', and laterRoles routes any future role to the admitting act rather than to this artifact. Rust occurs once, in a denial. All four earlier findings remain landed, with retainedEvidence, whatThisCloses, the corpus block and the verbatim carries byte-identical to frozen v2. Every mechanical check is clean: subject unmoved at 35e5d3c5 and 0444, eleven of eleven cited digests equal live bytes, six member strings ordered-exact against the live evidence cell with both fields present and all six guarded 'Once authored:', the ten-item corpus matching the live harness cell in order, CC-1..CC-11 matching control-protocol-contract.v2 and NT-3/NT-5/NT-4/NT-7 correctly excluded, the obligation partition equal to the live D-164 ten-member set, file 08 pin equal to live and unmodified, HEAD 5d5d778, required-now 26, thirty gate rows, prohibition scan clean.
